sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Stopping a rolling ball with your foot is called:
In Kabaddi, what line must the raider cross to make a valid raid?
When is the best time to take a water break during a long game?
options: B) When the game is paused or at half-time
questions.answer: B) When the game is paused or at half-time

options: B) Relax the body and bring in deep oxygen
questions.answer: B) Relax the body and bring in deep oxygen

questions.question_text: Shaking hands after a match is a sign of:
Foot-eye coordination is mainly used in which sport?
If you feel very thirsty and dizzy on the field, what is your body signaling?
options: B) You need to run faster
C) You are dehydrated and need water
D) You need to eat candy
questions.answer: C) You are dehydrated and need water

questions.question_text: A Kabaddi team on defense is trying to do what?
options: B) Catch and hold the raider until they lose their breath/chant
questions.answer: B) Catch and hold the raider until they lose their breath/chant

questions.question_text: To kick a ball accurately, your non-kicking foot should point:

options: B) Following the rules and respecting everyone
questions.answer: B) Following the rules and respecting everyone

questions.question_text: Explain why trapping the ball is important before kicking it to someone else.
questions.answer: Trapping the ball brings it under control, allowing you to look up and aim your pass accurately instead of kicking wildly.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the baulk line in Kabaddi?
questions.answer: The raider must cross the baulk line for the raid to be considered legal and valid; otherwise, they are declared out.

questions.question_text: How can you tell if your body needs a water break?
questions.answer: Your mouth feels dry, you sweat a lot, you feel unusually tired, or you feel very thirsty.

questions.question_text: Describe how to do a simple belly breathing exercise.
questions.answer: Place your hand on your belly, breathe in deeply through your nose so your belly expands like a balloon, and exhale slowly.

questions.question_text: Why do opposing teams shake hands after a match?
questions.answer: It shows respect for each other, acknowledges the effort both teams put in, and leaves no bad feelings after the competition.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks: In Kabaddi, the person who goes to the other team's side to tag players is called the _______, and they must hold their breath by chanting '_______'.
Match the body signal to the need: 1) Dry mouth and heavy sweating, 2) Heavy panting and muscle soreness. Options: A) Need to rest/cool down, B) Need hydration.
questions.answer: 1 matches with B, 2 matches with A

questions.question_text: You are defending in Kabaddi. The raider tags you, but you honestly believe they stopped chanting 'Kabaddi' for a second before the tag. What is the fair way to handle this?
questions.answer: I should state my claim politely to the referee. If the referee says I am out, I must accept the decision gracefully without throwing a tantrum, showing good sportsmanship.

questions.question_text: Plan a drill to help your classmates practice trapping and passing a ball with their feet.
questions.answer: Two students stand 5 meters apart. Student A gently passes the ball to Student B. Student B traps it with the sole of their foot, looks up, and passes it back using the inside of the foot. Repeat 10 times.
